    Portfolio analysis

    Scoring model

    Readiness is evidence-led

    Each indicator is rated Nascent, Emerging, Ready, Not assessable, or Not applicable. Numeric scores are assigned only to the first three ratings. Domain scores are the mean of scored applicable indicators.

    1Nascent
    2Emerging
    3Ready

    A domain is provisional below 75% evidence coverage. A school is Ready only when all six domains are scored, none is Nascent, the equal-domain mean is at least 2.34, and every domain meets the evidence threshold.

    Checklist design

    Short checks at clear pauses

    The form separates evidence capture, domain review, and final confirmation. Critical missing evidence is surfaced before submission. The checklist supports judgement; it does not replace it.

    Engagement pathway

    From direct delivery to institutionalisation

    1High dependencyVE leads core delivery and foundational support.
    2Assisted competencySchool staff co-deliver with sustained VE support.
    3Operational autonomySchool staff lead; VE mentors and develops trainers.
    4Full sustainabilitySchool systems sustain practice; VE monitors and refreshes.
